description: Handler function integration tests - utility functions for characters, objects, affects, and rooms

tests.name: handler_lookups_test
tests.description: Test weapon, class, skill and other lookup functions
tests.expected_outcome: all lookups return correct values for valid inputs

tests.name: handler_string_matching_test
tests.expected_outcome: string matching works correctly for partial and exact names

tests.name: handler_stats_attributes_test
tests.description: Test stat getters, setters and modifiers with fake player
tests.expected_outcome: stat calculations work correctly with exponential scaling

tests.name: handler_skills_weapons_test
tests.description: Test weapon skill and weapon sn functions
tests.expected_outcome: weapon skills return correct values for equipped weapons

tests.name: handler_counting_test
tests.description: Test count_users and other counting functions

tests.name: handler_object_weight_test
tests.description: Test object weight and value calculation functions
tests.expected_outcome: weight calculations handle containers and nested items correctly

tests.name: handler_affect_queries_test
tests.description: Test affect_find, is_affected and related affect query functions
tests.expected_outcome: affect queries work correctly with test affects on fake player

tests.name: handler_visibility_test
tests.description: Test can_see functions with NULL descriptor handling
tests.expected_outcome: visibility functions handle NULL descriptors gracefully

tests.name: handler_character_status_test
tests.expected_outcome: character status functions return correct boolean values

tests.name: handler_pronouns_test
tests.description: Test pronoun and body type functions
tests.expected_outcome: pronouns return correct strings for different character sexes
